summary: Plaintiff first raised fees in private reasoning before making a public proposal including both class relief and fees. Fees were negotiated during the same negotiation before final class relief was accepted. The transcript links fee reductions to increased class benefit, but it does not show self-dealing, defense leverage of fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
